name: Friedman Memorial Airport

runway.v: one runway, 13/31, 7,550 ft x 100 ft (about 2,301 m x 30 m)

curfew.v: voluntary: all operators are asked not to operate 23:00-07:00 local
curfew.quote: All aircraft operators are asked not to operate between the hours of 2300 and 0700 (local time)

hours.v: control tower 07:00-23:00 (stated as Mountain Standard Time); airfield surface conditions not monitored 23:00-07:00; not recommended for night use or marginal weather by unfamiliar pilots (mountainous terrain)
hours.quote: TOWER OPERATION HOURS: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM Mountain Standard Time

max_aircraft.v: pavement strength: 65,000 lb single wheel, 95,000 lb dual wheel, 150,000 lb dual tandem

noise.v: voluntary noise abatement programme; avoid landing from the north over Hailey when safe
noise.quote: Friedman Memorial Airport has a voluntary noise abatement program.

handling.v: the airport names Atlantic Aviation as its FBO (self-service fuel enquiries)

notes: Runway from the FAA airport diagram AL-6239 (Hailey, Friedman Meml) for the current d-TPP cycle 26 Nov-24 Dec 2026. Voluntary night request from the airport's Noise Abatement brochure (revised March 2023); other items from the airport's Pilot Information page (modified 22 Jan 2025). The briefed aircraft size or wingspan limit could not be confirmed from an official source: the pilot page gives only pavement strengths, and the master plan inventory PDF (http://iflysun.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/1.-SUN-MP-FINAL-Inventory-Chapter.pdf) looped on an http/https redirect. No customs statement found. Chart Supplement NW not opened.
